summary: Small Madonna and Child with a Pomegranate in the National Gallery of Art, Washington (1952.5.65), catalogued there as Lorenzo di Credi.

timeline.text: Small Madonna catalogued by its museum as Lorenzo di Credi. An attribution to the young Leonardo has been proposed.

claims.statement: The National Gallery of Art lists Madonna and Child with a Pomegranate, Lorenzo di Credi, 1475/1480, 16.5 x 13.4 cm, accession 1952.5.65, Samuel H. Kress Collection.
